# Nayovi

> Nayovi is a manhwa and manga translator for Android. Readers can open a manhwa, manga, or manhua chapter, choose a language, and continue reading the translated chapter inside the app.

Nayovi offers a one-time free trial of about two average chapters and optional monthly plans by estimated chapter volume. It does not host or distribute manga chapters or unauthorized catalogs.

## Official identity

- Brand domain: [nayovi.com](https://nayovi.com)
- Primary product site: [tachiyomiat.com](https://tachiyomiat.com)
- SEO discovery domain: [translate-manhwa-ai.com](https://translate-manhwa-ai.com)
- Official APK source: [tachiyomiat.com/download](https://tachiyomiat.com/download)
- Support: [tachiyomiat.com/support](https://tachiyomiat.com/support)

## Product facts

- Platform: Android APK.
- Free access: one-time trial of about two average chapters; no card required.
- Paid access: monthly plans based on estimated chapter volume.
- Activation: instructions and an activation code are sent after confirmed payment.
- Billing: monthly plans renew until cancelled; unused allowance resets at renewal.
- Content boundary: process only owned, public-domain, official-sample, or permission-approved material.
